Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent modular character animation atlas for Pocket Mechanic.
Image 1 is the edit target, Kip's existing 4 columns by 2 rows animation sheet.
Preserve EXACTLY all eight characters, their order, poses, copper round body silhouette, brass faceplate, turquoise patina patch, spring arms, articulated hands, spring legs, lighting, rendering style, and tiny smiles/mouth expressions. Keep the same four by two grid, equal cells, consistent identical character scale and baseline, and generous transparent gutters. These are sprite animation frames for one character, not eight different robots.
Make ONLY these removals in EVERY cell so accessories can be attached dynamically: remove the entire winding key behind the body's left side including its shaft; remove the entire light-bulb antenna above the head including the stalk and glow; remove both shoe shells at the ends of the spring legs, leaving short bare spring leg ends; remove both eye assemblies including lenses, rims and pupils, and fill their previous area seamlessly with the same softly shaded smooth golden faceplate metal. Do not add eye sockets or holes or any replacement shapes. Keep the small smile below the blank area for modular eyes. Reconstruct smooth body surfaces where the removed parts intersect, without halos, scars, marks or patches.
The final image must have genuine transparent alpha background, clean anti-aliased edges, no red matte, black matte or checkerboard, no shadows cast onto a ground plane. No hats, badges, keys, antennas, lenses or shoes. Do not change body proportions or identity. Preserve tangible softly painted copper and turquoise with rich bevels and highlights. Large high-quality sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas of miniature accessories for Pocket Mechanic. Reference image is an APPROVED STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not the layout to reproduce. Blend all three columns' materials: aged brass and copper, stitched fabric, cheerful enamel, wood, glass, and botanical details. Match its rich dimensional children's storybook rendering, soft top-left warm lighting, bevels and contact shading, crisp readable silhouettes, slight three-quarter/front perspective. No robots, hands, background scenes, captions, lettering, labels or grid rules. Genuine transparent alpha background including holes inside items; no ground plane, backdrop, drop shadows, halos, matte or checkerboard. Each item centered wholly within its EXACT equal-sized grid cell with at least 12 percent empty padding on all four sides. No item may touch or overlap any other cell. Row-major order is mandatory, exactly the specified item count. All items should have comparable visual scale and polish. Render actual objects rather than symbols or flat vector shapes.
